title: "Run GWAS with GAPIT"

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = F, warning = F)
```

# Instal `GAPIT`

```{r eval = F}
devtools::install_github("jiabowang/GAPIT")
```

# Load `GAPIT`

```{r eval = F}
library(GAPIT)
```

Before the `gwaspr` package can be used, we first need to run GWAS with `GAPIT`.

# Data

- [Genotype data (gwaspr_myG_hmp.zip)](gwaspr_myG_hmp.zip)
- [Phenotype data (gwaspr_myY.csv)](gwaspr_myY.csv)
- [Covariate data (gwaspr_myCV.csv)](gwaspr_myCV.csv)

# Genotype data (myG)

Our population, the LDP, was genotyped using an *exome caputure array* and filtered with the following criteria to yield a data set of 336,367 SNPs, stored in our object `myG`.

- Only Bi-allelic           =  TRUE
- Minimum Read Depth        =  3
- Minor Allele Frequency    = >5%
- Maximum Missing Frequency =  25%
- Heterozygous              = <25%

> Note: `header = T`

```{r}
# Load our genotype file in hapmap format (note: header = F)
myG <- read.csv("Data/gwaspr_myG_hmp.csv", header = F)
```

```{r}
# Map + marker Info
myG[1:10,1:11]
# genotrype calls
myG[1:10,12:17]
```

# Phenotype data (myY)

```{r}
# Load our phenotype file
myY <- read.csv("Data/gwaspr_myY.csv")
```

```{r}
myY[1:15,c("myG_Name","Cot_RvY","DTF_Nepal_2017","DTF_Sask_2017")]
```

---

# Run GWAS

Run GWAS on the 3 traits `myY`

```{r eval = F}
# Run GWAS
myGAPIT <- GAPIT( 
  # Phenotype data
  Y = myY[,c("myG_Name","Cot_RvY","DTF_Nepal_2017","DTF_Sask_2017")],
  # Genotype data
  G = myG, 
  # Set PCA number
  PCA.total = 4,
  # Select Models
  model = c("GLM","MLM","MLMM","FarmCPU","BLINK") )
```

---

# GWAS with covariate

Run GWAS on the `DTF_Sask_2017` trait with `b` as a covariate.

```{r eval = F}
# Prep data
myY2 <- myY[,c("Name","DTF_Sask_2017")]
# Rename the trait to be rerun with a covariate
colnames(myY2)[2] <- "DTF_Sask_2017_CV_b"
# Run GWAS with a covariate
myGAPIT <- GAPIT(
  # Phenotype data
  Y = myY2[,c("myG_Name","DTF_Sask_2017_CV_b")],
  # Genotype data
  G = myG,
  # Covariate data
  CV = myY[,c("myG_Name","b_coef")],
  # Set PCA number
  PCA.total = 0,
  # Select Models
  model = c("GLM","MLM","MLMM","FarmCPU","BLINK") )
```
